name: Rufina Rigerd
original_name: ルフィーナ・リジェルド
source:
Rufeena is Art's one and only living relative, his little sister. She is a serious girl who does all the domestic chores at the Regerald house. Even so, Rufeena is a bit clumsy.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20031206133506fw_/http://www.gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/new/2001/0126_card_of_distiny/index.htm]Gamelex[/url]]
